[LSTR.8.3] An adapter that violates LSTR.8.1 — emitting a
`String` slot whose bytes are not valid UTF-8 — is a runtime
adapter error per [LECC.3.7].

**The obligation is the adapter's and the fact does not arrive.** A value that
does not fit a declared non-`Json` slot is [LADP.5.6.1]'s case: the adapter
coerces or refuses to emit, and a metric increments so operators see the
mismatch ([LADP.5.6.2]). Nothing reaches the engine, so no activation fires on
the affected slot and no fault is raised on the rule's behalf. Where an adapter
hands the engine such a value all the same, the engine refuses it
([LSTR.8.5]).
